Contrast: FileMonitor → BackgroundIndexer performs INCREMENTAL re-index of a single file (steps 12–21).
POST /api/v1/reload clears the in-memory cache only; the full graph rebuild runs via GraphBuilder only if triggered by a new knowcode analyze.
